notes.title: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia Deluxe Edition contents currently not accessible
notes.content:
Currently, people who purchased the DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia Deluxe Edition are unable to access the Deluxe Edition contents:

- Digital Art Collection (13 Pages)
[i]+ Character art collection
+ Rough art collection[/i]
- 2 Audio Dramas in Japanese and Drama Script in English and Traditional Chinese (PDF)
[i]+ Natsumi Encounter
+ Origami Friendship[/i]
- Official Soundtrack (27 tracks)
- Short Novel in Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese
[i]+ Ren Masques[/i]

Idea Factory International is aware of this issue and is working to resolve it promptly. Thank you for your understanding and patience.

notes.title: DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia is OUT NOW! + Teaser Trailer Live
notes.content:
Idea Factory International are excited to announce that the latest game in the [i]DATE A LIVE[/i] universe, [i]DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia[/i] is out now for Steam®! 

To celebrate this release, you can get a sneak peek at the dark mysteries that await Shido and the Spirits with the all-new [i]DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia[/i] Teaser Trailer:

[previewyoutube=mDHWPrgJ_2U;full][/previewyoutube]

If you already own the first game in the series, [i]DATE A LIVE: Rio Reincarnation[/i], on Steam®, you qualify for a 10% Complete the Set Bundle discount on [i]DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia[/i]. 

You can also grab either the base game of [i]DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia[/i] game or the Deluxe Edition with a 15% weeklong launch discount.

[b]The Deluxe Edition Includes:[/b]
- Digital Art Collection (13 Pages)
+ [i]Character art collection[/i]
+ [i]Rough art collection[/i]
- 2 Audio Dramas in Japanese and Drama Script in English and Traditional Chinese (PDF)
+ [i]Natsumi Encounter[/i]
+ [i]Origami Friendship[/i]
- Official Soundtrack (27 tracks)
- Short Novel in Japanese, English, and Traditional Chinese
+ [i]Ren Masques[/i]

* You can access the Deluxe Edition contents in the game folder. Right-click the game in your Steam Library, select "Browse Local Files", then open the "Assets" folder.

Check out the official [url=https://ifi.games/date-a-live-ren-dystopia/][i]DATE A LIVE: Ren Dystopia[/i] website[/url] for more information on the game. 

Purchase the game on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2627780/DATE_A_LIVE_Ren_Dystopia/]Steam®[/url] today!
